movies.title: Detour
movies.description: A broke New York pianist hitchhikes west to join his girlfriend, but a stranger's death plunges him into a fatal nightmare.

scenes.transcription: [Highway ambience, distant car engines, wind blowing across the desert road]
scenes.visual_description: Opening title tracking shot along a desolate desert highway leading toward a lonely roadside diner.
scenes.synopsis: The fateful journey begins as Al Roberts wanders into a remote diner, haggard and exhausted.

scenes.transcription: I don't know what made me drop that nickel in the jukebox. It was an old song... one I hadn't heard in years.
scenes.visual_description: Close-up on Al Roberts' haggard, unshaven face lit by harsh diner light, cigarette smoke swirling across the frame.
scenes.synopsis: A jukebox melody triggers painful flashbacks of Sue and the life Al left behind in New York.

scenes.transcription: Sue, you're crazy to go out there. Hollywood's a graveyard for talent.
scenes.visual_description: Backstage dressing room, low-key lighting casting venetian blind shadows across the piano.
scenes.synopsis: Al tries to dissuade Sue from leaving for California, foreshadowing his own doomed cross-country trip.
